d: Spiky, cobalt blue hair stands up in sharp peaks, accented by a red headband. Sharp, narrowed eyes are a glowing golden-yellow, set in a youthful, adolescent face with a fierce expression. The build is athletic and lean, dressed in a navy blue martial arts outfit featuring a sleeveless top, baggy trousers with a yellow and red flame motif on the left leg, and a white fabric wrap around the waist. Accessories include a large red beaded necklace, spiked metallic bands around the wrists and ankles, white bandages wrapped around the lower legs, and open-toed black sandals.
